description: Show the Rebase Cloud project this directory is linked to (`rebase cloud status`). Its URL, status, last deploy, runtime, database and storage. While the project is unclaimed, `unclaimed` carries its claim URL and when it is deleted; `blockedOn`/`nextAction` name anything only the user can do.

project.description: The project to act on: a registered project's name (rebase_project_list), or a Rebase Cloud project's slug or id. Optional when the session's directory is linked to the intended project. Refused when it names a different project than the directory's link.

name: rebase_cloud_status
